_comment: Master manifest of external replay datasets (see TRAINING_EXTRA_DATASETS.md).
Used by BOTH scripts/setup_env.sh (via training/download_external.py, to know
what to fetch/generate) and the run scripts (via
Fields: name (also the folder name under data_external/); kind 'hf' or
max_rows (cap on SOURCE rows read; null = all; Cauldron rows fan out to
several examples); converter (key into external_data.CONVERTERS); loss 'ce'
(strengthen: train on the dataset's targets) or 'kd' (preserve: match the
student's logits to the untrained base model over the same tokens);
examples_per_epoch (ABSOLUTE per-epoch quota -- mixture share never depends
on dataset size); probe (fixed eval slice: split/n/kind); micro_batch_cap
(optional, cap the training micro-batch for this source -- set 1 for
long-TARGET kd sources whose kept-logit tensors OOM at full micro-batch,

datasets.name: gsm8k
datasets.notes: Grade-school arithmetic word problems (7.5k). CE: arithmetic is the analyst-drift compensator, we want to strengthen it.

datasets.name: metamathqa
datasets.notes: Augmented GSM8K/MATH questions with worked solutions (395k total, capped).

datasets.name: orca_math
datasets.notes: Synthetic math word problems with solutions (200k total, capped).

datasets.name: numinamath_cot
datasets.notes: Competition-style math with chain-of-thought solutions (860k total, capped). Extra arithmetic+reasoning depth.

datasets.name: navigation
datasets.notes: Generated locally (training/synth_navigation.py): clock hour <-> degrees <-> radians, compass point <-> bearing, bearing differences, shortest-rotation direction. Matches this repo's conventions (bearing clockwise from 12 o'clock, hour = 30 deg). Directly targets the geometry failure modes. 300 -> 900 on 2026-08-05: the game corpus clones tolerated (+-2h) geometry errors, so the aug4 runs degraded this benchmark (0.054 -> 0.175 nats held-out by the final eval); tripling the quota (~5% -> ~14% of epoch gradient mass) counteracts that pressure directly, and its guard stays STRICT on purpose.

datasets.name: openthoughts
datasets.notes: Long-form reasoning traces (math/science/code/puzzles). KD: preserve general reasoning, don't teach another model's style. micro_batch_cap=1: the TARGET is nearly the whole sequence, so KD kept-logit tensors are batch x seq x 262k-vocab -- a full micro-batch OOM'd t10 on 2026-07-31 (~23k positions, 11.4 GiB per copy).

datasets.name: slimorca
datasets.notes: General instruction following (518k total, capped). KD: preserve English/agentic tone.

datasets.name: cauldron_vqav2
datasets.notes: General VQA over natural images. KD: preserve non-game vision. Substitutes LLaVA-OneVision from the original candidate list (same purpose, one clean download path).

datasets.name: cauldron_cocoqa
datasets.notes: COCO-image QA. KD: preserve non-game vision.

datasets.name: cauldron_ai2d
datasets.notes: Diagram QA (2.4k rows, taken whole). Closest public proxy to schematic/board-like images.

datasets.name: sharegpt4video
datasets.notes: PLACEHOLDER, no converter yet. Video comprehension replay -- sidelined by priority, not necessity (rationale in TRAINING_EXTRA_DATASETS.md: towers are LoRA-frozen so drift risk is low; enabling needs a converter, a micro_batch_cap, and a t10 re-profile -- many frames = long-sequence KD). The downloader refuses loudly if enabled without a converter.

datasets.name: audio_qa
datasets.notes: PLACEHOLDER, no dataset chosen and no converter yet. Audio comprehension replay -- sidelined by priority, not necessity (rationale in TRAINING_EXTRA_DATASETS.md). Before writing any code, verify remotely that the deployed 12B checkpoint accepts audio input at all (docs only promise audio for Gemma 4 E4B).
